features.name: Establish repository harness
features.description: Create and validate restartable instructions, state, verification, scope, and lifecycle artifacts for local-agent development.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md routes agents through the harness startup and end-of-session workflows.
feature_list.json, progress.md, init.sh, and session-handoff.md exist and agree on the active feature.
validate-harness reports a passing score and focused verification evidence is recorded.
The user reviews and approves the harness before feature code changes begin.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: user approved the harness. validate-harness passed 100/100 (all five subsystems 5/5). ./init.sh: format check passed; local_agent_runtime tests passed (4 unit, 17 integration, 1 ignored doc test); Warp focused tests blocked before execution because the Xcode Metal Toolchain is not installed. init.sh now detects this prerequisite and prints the installation command.

features.name: Lossless supported-tool transcript restoration
features.description: Round-trip every locally supported tool call and result across persisted conversation history without dropping IDs, errors, cancellations, or route information.
acceptance_criteria: Built-in, edit_files, MCP tool/resource, and read_skill calls restore with matching call IDs and arguments.
Tool results preserve semantic content and error/cancel state.
Malformed historical pairs are omitted or repaired as a pair, never left orphaned.
Round-trip regression tests cover every registered local tool family.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added a versioned canonical transcript envelope and centralized proto codec for built-ins, edit_files, MCP tools/resources, and skills. Exact generated MCP names, IDs, JSON arguments, result content, and error state round-trip. Orphaned historical pairs are filtered. Extended typed result persistence. Focused Warp tests passed: 29/29.

features.name: Context budget and compaction
features.description: Enforce a provider-facing context budget while preserving persisted history and tool-call/result pairing.
acceptance_criteria: Request context limits are propagated into RuntimeConfig.
System prompt, tool schemas, expected output, and conversation history share one explicit budget.
Old tool results and complete old turns compact without splitting call/result pairs.
Recent turns remain intact and impossible budgets fail with a structured error.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Propagated RequestParams.context_window_limit; reserved output and tool-schema budget; added pair-preserving complete-turn compaction with structured summaries, recent-turn preservation, and model-only tool-result compaction. Impossible budgets return ContextBudgetExceeded. local_agent_runtime tests passed: 24/24 plus 1 ignored doc test; focused Warp tests passed: 29/29.

features.name: Provider retry, continuation, and stall recovery
features.description: Make Ollama calls recover from bounded transient failures, context overflow, max-token termination, and repeated no-progress loops.
acceptance_criteria: Retryable provider failures use bounded cancellation-aware backoff.
Context overflow triggers compaction before one bounded retry.
Max-token responses continue without duplicating streamed output.
Repeated identical no-progress cycles stop with a structured reason.
The hard 10-turn integration cap is replaced by a documented safe policy.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Classified Ollama transient, rate-limit, timeout, model-not-found, and context-overflow failures. Added bounded cancellation-aware exponential retries, one context-tightening overflow retry, bounded max-token continuation, paired repeated-tool-call stall termination, and a 100-turn absolute safety ceiling. local_agent_runtime tests passed: 28/28 plus 1 ignored doc test. Local runtime clippy passed with -D warnings.

features.name: Resumable ask-user flow
features.description: Expose Warp's existing ask-user action to the local runtime and return structured answer, skip, cancel, and error results to the model.
acceptance_criteria: The tool is advertised only when ask-user is enabled and executable.
The runtime waits for the existing Warp UI action result.
Answer, skip, cancellation, and error outcomes preserve one call/result pair.
Bridge and executor tests cover all outcomes.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added request-gated ask_user_question schema and mapped it to Warp's existing interactive AskUserQuestion action. Answered, skipped, auto-skipped, error, and cancellation outcomes return structured model results and persist through the transcript codec. Focused Warp tests passed.

features.name: Runtime permission modes and policy propagation
features.description: Add Default, AcceptEdits, and Plan modes without bypassing Warp's protected-path, organization, isolation, or risky-command policy.
acceptance_criteria: Permission mode semantics are exhaustive and documented.
Plan mode removes or denies mutating built-in and MCP schemas.
AcceptEdits never bypasses protected paths or risky shell policy.
Approval cancellation and resumed execution preserve one call/result pair.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added Default, AcceptEdits, and Plan request modes. Plan mode removes mutating built-in and MCP schemas while retaining read-only tools and ask-user. Default and AcceptEdits continue through Warp's existing action UI, preserving protected-path, isolation, and risky-command policy.

features.name: Executable capability and prompt consistency
features.description: Derive local prompt capabilities from the same tool registry used for execution so enabled settings are never presented as unavailable tools.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt and runtime use one registry snapshot per request.
Planning, web, computer, research, and orchestration are not advertised without matching schemas.
Active MCP and skill tools are described accurately.
Focused prompt tests prevent registry/prompt drift.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: The runtime and prompt now consume the same request-scoped LocalRuntimeToolRegistry snapshot. Prompt output lists only executable schemas, includes permission mode, and explicitly marks planning/web/computer/research/orchestration unavailable without matching schemas. Focused prompt/bridge tests passed.

features.name: Phase A reliability gate
features.description: Run automated and manual parity checks against a pinned Ollama model and context window before beginning autonomy work.
acceptance_criteria: All focused tests, formatting, and relevant clippy checks pass.
A run with at least 15 tool calls completes without orphaned results or context overflow.
Manual read, edit, shell, search, ask-user, denial, cancellation, and resume prompts pass on the pinned model.
Failures and follow-up features are recorded with evidence.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Phase A gate passed: harness 100/100, format and git diff checks, local_agent_runtime 29 automated tests, focused Warp local_runtime 32 tests, and local_agent_runtime clippy with -D warnings. Live parity passed over SSH to bcl-2 using Ollama 0.20.2, qwen3-coder:latest, and its 262144-token context: 15 sequential real model tool calls completed in 9.64s with exact pairing. Full Warp clippy remains independently blocked by two pre-existing warpui_core unnecessary_unwrap findings; cold macOS builds still require the Xcode Metal Toolchain.

features.name: LiteLLM / OpenAI-compatible local provider discovery
features.description: Allow the existing Ollama local-runtime settings and provider path to talk to LiteLLM and other OpenAI-compatible proxies by normalizing /v1 base URLs and falling back from /api/tags to /v1/models.
acceptance_criteria: Base URLs with a trailing /v1 are normalized before /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models are appended.
Settings Test Connection lists models from Ollama /api/tags or LiteLLM /v1/models.
Settings copy documents LiteLLM / OpenAI-compatible proxy support.
Focused provider unit tests cover URL normalization and OpenAI models JSON parsing.
features.evidence: 2026-07-24: Extended OllamaClient and OllamaProvider list_models to fall back from /api/tags to /v1/models; normalize_base_url strips trailing /v1. Settings UI renamed to Ollama / LiteLLM and documents host:4000(/v1). Live probe against http://100.95.111.65:4000 returned /api/tags 404 and /v1/models 200 with 20 models. local_agent_runtime tests passed (9 unit + 22 integration, 1 ignored live). Clippy -D warnings and format --check passed for the crate.

features.name: Ollama/LiteLLM model picker dropdown
features.description: Replace the free-text Ollama model field with a searchable dropdown populated from the connected model list.
acceptance_criteria: Settings Model control is a FilterableDropdown filled from Connected models.
Selecting a model persists via ApiKeyManager.set_ollama_model.
Saved selection remains visible before Test Connection refreshes the full list.
features.evidence: 2026-07-24: Replaced Ollama model text field with FilterableDropdown populated from Connected model list; SetOllamaModel persists selection. Settings copy notes tool-calling requirement. App rebuilt and launched via ./script/run.

features.name: Recover Qwen-style text tool calls from LiteLLM/Ollama
features.description: When a local model emits <function=...> XML in assistant text instead of OpenAI tool_calls, parse those calls and continue the agent tool loop.
acceptance_criteria: Qwen-style <function=name><parameter=...> XML in assistant text is parsed into ToolCall values.
Recovered calls set stop_reason to ToolUse so the runtime executes tools.
Unit tests cover file_glob_v2, shell command, and multi-call cases.
features.evidence: 2026-07-24: Confirmed qwen3-coder via LiteLLM returns finish_reason=stop with tool_calls=null and Qwen XML in content. Added extract_qwen_style_tool_calls recovery in OllamaProvider chat/chat_stream. Unit tests 4/4; local_agent_runtime suite passed; clippy -D warnings passed.

features.name: Local agent read-only shell auto-run and search guidance
features.description: Infer is_read_only for find/ls-style shell commands, withhold Qwen tool XML from streamed text, and document that file_glob_v2 is project-scoped while home directory searches should use read-only shell.
acceptance_criteria: find/ls-style shell commands without an explicit is_read_only flag are treated as read-only for scheduling and Warp auto-execute.
Streamed assistant text withholds Qwen <function=...> markup from TextDelta events.
Tool schemas and local system prompt guide folder searches under ~ via read-only shell.
features.evidence: 2026-07-24: Added infer_shell_command_is_read_only (+ /dev/null redirect allowance), safety_class_for_call ReadOnly path, stream markup withholding, and prompt/schema search guidance. local_agent_runtime and focused Warp infer tests passed.

features.name: Bounded local run_agents delegation
features.description: When orchestration is enabled, advertise a local-runtime run_agents tool that bridges to Warp's existing RunAgents action with depth and concurrency bounds (root-only, max 4 local children).
acceptance_criteria: run_agents is advertised only when RequestParams.orchestration_enabled is true and the request is not itself a child agent (parent_agent_id is None).
Tool calls map to AIAgentActionType::RunAgents with Local execution mode and at most 4 agent_run_configs.
Invalid input (empty agents, too many agents, missing fields) returns structured ToolExecutionError::InvalidInput.
Plan mode does not advertise run_agents; results convert to model-facing content and typed transcript proto where available.
Focused bridge unit tests cover enablement, conversion, bounds, and result content.
features.evidence: 2026-07-27: Bridged run_agents into LocalRuntimeToolRegistry when orchestration_enabled and parent_agent_id is None. Forces Local execution mode, caps agents at LOCAL_RUN_AGENTS_MAX_CHILDREN=4, maps results to JSON content + typed RunAgentsResult proto (cancel remains generic). Plan mode strips run_agents. cargo test -p warp local_runtime --lib --features local_ollama_runtime_tool_use: 39 passed. ./script/format --check: passed.

features.name: Background shell and process lifecycle
features.description: Allow local-runtime shell commands to run without blocking on completion, and bridge read/write long-running shell tools so the model can poll output and send input by block_id.
acceptance_criteria: run_shell_command accepts optional wait_until_complete (default true); false returns a long-running snapshot with block_id.
read_shell_command_output and write_to_long_running_shell_command are advertised and map to existing Warp actions.
Result content for LRC poll/write is structured JSON for the model; typed proto results persist when available.
Plan mode keeps read_shell_command_output and strips write_to_long_running_shell_command.
Focused bridge unit tests cover schema, conversion, and result content.
features.evidence: 2026-07-27: Added wait_until_complete on run_shell_command (default true); built-in read_shell_command_output + write_to_long_running_shell_command bridge to Warp LRC actions; JSON result content + typed proto. Plan mode retains read LRC only. cargo test -p warp local_runtime --lib --features local_ollama_runtime_tool_use: 40 passed. ./script/format --check: passed.

features.name: Model-gated computer and document actions
features.description: Advertise Warp document tools to the local runtime, and computer-use tools only when RequestParams.computer_use_enabled is true; map calls to existing client actions with structured model-facing results.
acceptance_criteria: read_documents, edit_documents, and create_documents are advertised and map to AIAgentActionType document variants.
request_computer_use and use_computer are advertised only when computer_use_enabled is true.
Plan mode retains read_documents and strips mutating document and computer-use tools.
Tool results serialize to structured JSON for the model; focused unit tests cover gating and conversion.
features.evidence: 2026-07-28: Bridged read/edit/create_documents always for local agents; request_computer_use + use_computer when computer_use_enabled. Structured JSON results (screenshot metadata only). Plan mode keeps read_documents, strips mutating docs and CU. cargo test -p warp local_runtime --lib --features local_ollama_runtime_tool_use: 41 passed. ./script/format --check: passed.

features.name: Skill discovery and bundled catalog for local runtime
features.description: Advertise list_skills and read_skill from the cwd/home/bundled SkillManager catalog (not only skills attached to request context), inject a short catalog into the system prompt, and return structured list results without requiring a Warp action card.
acceptance_criteria: Local runtime resolves available skills via SkillManager for the session working directory when starting a run.
list_skills and read_skill are advertised when the catalog is non-empty.
list_skills returns name, description, reference, and scope without executing a UI action.
System prompt includes a concise available-skills section when the catalog is non-empty.
Focused unit tests cover catalog registration, list_skills content, and plan-mode retention of list/read skill tools.
features.evidence: 2026-07-28: ResponseStream resolves SkillManager catalog for cwd; from_request_with_available_skills registers list_skills + read_skill; list_skills answered in WarpToolExecutor without UI; prompt Available Skills section; plan mode keeps list/read. cargo test -p warp local_runtime --lib --features local_ollama_runtime_tool_use: 42 passed. format --check: passed.
